6470.commentary: (VINa) apalāḷetabbā'ti aññaṃ laḷato upasevato apagametabbā. parisabhūte sāmaṇer'ūpasampanne'ti yojanā.

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, aññassa parisā apalāḷetabbā. yo apalāḷeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā ti.

6471.commentary: (VINa) apalāḷentī'ti tumhākaṃ pattaṃ dassāma, cīvaraṃ dassāmā'ti attano upaṭṭhānakaraṇ'atthaṃ saṅgaṇhanti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sāmaṇere apalāḷenti. therā sāmaṃ dantakaṭṭham'pi mukh'odakam'pi gaṇhantā kilamanti.
idha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya, idaṃ jātu vedagū, idaṃ jātu sabbajī, idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇin'ti

6478.meaning1: not stuck in the mud; not immersed in mire; not bogged down

examples.text: so vata, cunda, attanā palipapalipanno paraṃ palipapalipannaṃ uddharissatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. so vata, cunda, attanā apalipapalipanno paraṃ palipapalipannaṃ uddharissatī'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.

6482.commentary: (ANt) jivhāya hatthaṃ apalekhati avalekhati udakena adhovanato. dutiyavikappe'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: hatth'āpalekhano'ti hatthe piṇḍamhi niṭṭhite jivhāya hatthaṃ apalekhati, uccāram'pi katvā hatthasmiṃ'y'eva daṇḍakasaññī hutvā hatthena apalekhati.

6483.commentary: (DNa) hatth'āpalekhano'ti hatthe piṇḍamhi ṭhite jivhāya hatthaṃ apalikhati, uccāraṃ vā katvā hatthasmiññ'eva daṇḍakasaññī hutvā hatthena apalikhati.

6485.meaning2: falling down through the loss of plaster

examples.text: dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ apalokanakammaṃ ñattikammaṃ ñattidutiyakammaṃ ñatticatutthakammaṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ.

6487.meaning1: (vinaya) legal action to obtain permission; act of giving notice

examples.text: dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ apalokanakammaṃ ñattikammaṃ ñattidutiyakammaṃ ñatticatutthakammaṃ dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ dhammikaṃ nāma kammaṃ.

6488.meaning2: looks towards; looks back; looks to, considers

6489.meaning2: looks to for approval, consults; asks permission; asks or takes leave

6490.commentary: (MNa) avalokayamānā'ti sirasmiṃ añjaliṃ ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ olokentāva paccosakkitvā dassanavijahanaṭṭhāne vanditvā gacchanti.

examples.text: te tena bhotā gotamena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamanti apalokayamānā'y'eva avijahitattā.

6492.meaning2: looked up to, obtained permission from, gave notice
6492.commentary: (ANa) apalokitā vā anapalokitā vā'ti āpucchitā vā anāpucchitā vā. na hi me te āpucchitā yānavāhanasampattiṃ, na ca issariyavisesaṃ dassanti, n'āpi anāpucchitā harissanti, aphalaṃ etesaṃ āpucchanan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: kiṃ h'ime karissanti nigaṇṭhā apalokitā vā anapalokitā vā? yaṃnūn'āhaṃ anapaloketvā'va nigaṇṭhe taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan'ti.

6493.meaning1: not fallen apart; not dissolved; not disintegrated; epithet of Nibbāna
6493.construction: na > a + pa + √luj > log > lok + ita

examples.text: apalokitañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi apalokitagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha. katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, apalokita

6494.meaning1: leading to the non-disintegrating; going to the non-dissolving; (or) not leading to disintegration

examples.text: apalokitañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi apalokitagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

apalokento kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sabbakāyen'eva apaloketi, so na uddhaṃ ulloketi, na adho oloketi, na ca vipekkhamāno gacchati, yugamattañ'ca pekkhati, tato c'assa uttari anāvaṭaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ bhavati.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso āpāthagatānaṃ rūpānaṃ adassanakāmo assa, so nimīleyya vā aññena vā apalokeyya.
na kho no, bhante, apalokito āyasmā sāriputto'ti. apaloketha, bhikkhave, sāriputtaṃ. sāriputto, bhikkhave, paṇḍito, bhikkhūnaṃ anuggāhako sabrahmacārīnan'ti.

6498.meaning1: having looked back; having looked behind

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā apaloketvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, rūpaṃ… n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabban'ti.

6499.meaning1: having obtained permission (from); having given notice (to)

examples.text: evaṃ mahāsatto khuddakamakkhikāya pivanamattam'pi lohitaṃ anuppādetvā satta rājāno palāpetvā kaniṭṭhabhātaraṃ apaloketvā kāme pahāya isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā abhiññā ca samāpattiyo ca nibbattetvā jīvitapariyosāne brahmalok'ūpago ahosi.
